theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfr_face_geometry
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ), volume {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} = 1 ∧ ∀ p q : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ), StrictMono p.1 → StrictMono q.1 → (∀ y y' : Euclid k, dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = dist y y') ∧ (∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt P) ∧ (p ≠ q → ∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∨ ∃ j, min (y j) (1 - y j) ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
